baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Tomb Kings (Priest-King dynasties, Mortuary Cult, eternal legions of the dead, caste-bound living population)
baseline.why: An undead Tomb King rules absolutely through the Mortuary Cult with tireless standing legions; a closed, caste-bound society with no schools or police beyond the guard of the dead

laws.lawgroup_trade_policy.source: canon: WFB Tomb Kings (Zandri is the living trading port of Nehekhara)
laws.lawgroup_trade_policy.why: A merchant port trades openly with the outside world.

laws.lawgroup_army_model.why: A living merchant city relies on its citizen levies, not legions of the dead.

laws.lawgroup_slavery.why: A living merchant city; the pyramid-era bondage of the Tomb Kings does not apply.
